verdict.rationale: Pigment documents an official MCP server that lets external agents such as Claude, Cursor and Codex build and edit Pigment models, with admin-approved, role-scoped access. Pigment also documents data-block-level edit histories and an Audit Trail API. Nothing in the evidence says agent or MCP edits are recorded in the same history as human edits. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that agent-made changes land in the same audit trail as human edits, scenario/forecast-specific write operations via the interface, published API/OpenAPI reference detail (OpenAPI probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
